opening: I have a large wound on my lower right leg.
Five years ago I had a confirmed deep vein thrombosis, a blood clot, in my right leg.
My mother and my brother had similar problems with their legs.

opening.text: I have a large wound on my lower right leg that's been there for 6 months. My legs are also swollen. Five years ago I had a confirmed deep vein thrombosis, a blood clot, in my right leg, and my mother and my brother had similar problems with their legs.
